integrity: The eight embedded public artifacts are complete UTF-8 files with individually verified byte counts and SHA-256 digests. Two exhaustive, differently implemented graph-verification programs ran successfully.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite classification of the 18-vertex Pappus incidence graph only; no infinite extension or independently checked priority claim. Full move graphs require optimality at every intermediate configuration.
title: Secure-guard spectra and exact relocation distances on the Pappus incidence graph
